report_name: NIST Seeks Public Input on Human-Centered Cybersecurity

identities.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology
identities.description: The U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) is seeking public feedback on a draft concept paper for a human-centered approach to cybersecurity.

identities.name: U.S. Federal Agencies
identities.description: A class of organizations that will be affected by the new NIST guidance on human-centered cybersecurity, as they are often required to follow NIST guidance.

identities.name: Critical Infrastructure Operators
identities.description: A class of organizations that will be affected by the new NIST guidance, as they increasingly align with NIST frameworks.

identities.name: Private Sector Companies
identities.description: A class of organizations that will be affected by the new NIST guidance, as many voluntarily adopt NIST standards.

identities.name: Cybersecurity Vendors
identities.description: A class of organizations that will be affected by the new NIST guidance, as they will need to consider human-centered design principles in their products.
